subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should processRestartRequired remain an additive generic ChannelAccountSnapshot contract that any channel can publish, or should Telegram request the hard recovery boundary through a narrower owner-specific injected seam?
rationale: Both designs can fix the incident safely, but the choice establishes who may request whole-gateway replacement and whether that authority becomes a permanent extension-facing channel contract.

options.title: Keep the generic contract
options.body: Retain the channel-agnostic snapshot flag, document its strict semantics, and require exact-head restart and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Use a Telegram-owned seam
options.body: Replace the shared snapshot field with a narrow injected restart request while retaining supervisor detection, durable rolling limits, and fail-closed arbitration.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic contract
recommendation.body: Retain the channel-agnostic snapshot flag, document its strict semantics, and require exact-head restart and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on Telegram polling lifecycle and was already asked in the PR discussion to decide the owner boundary.
